title: Spec: AppDataDictionary extensions in UpdateRoomResponse, UpdateRequest, KeyMaterialRequest and each ClientKeyMaterial
description: Draft PR to ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol for #190: add an extensions field (AppDataDictionary, like consent_extensions and id_request_extensions) to UpdateRoomResponse, UpdateRequest, KeyMaterialRequest and ClientKeyMaterial in protocol-07 §5.2/§5.3. Say a receiver MUST ignore entries it does not know. Mention IETF 127 interop table origin. Posting needs Mark's OK.
notes:
Draft on MarkAtwood/mimi-protocol branch extension-points-190 (a94e6f2): AppDataDictionary key_material_request_extensions (in Request and TBS), client_key_material_extensions, update_extensions, update_response_extensions; 'a receiver ignores any component it does not recognize'. Builds with kramdown-rfc + xml2rfc (LANG=C.UTF-8, aasvg in /data/ietf-tools/node). PR to ietf-wg-mimi not opened: needs Mark's OK. Refusal-reason component + URN registry is a separate PR.
Draft PR opened at Mark's request: ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol#220 (from extension-points-190, a94e6f2). Body raises the open question: key_material_request_extensions inside the TBS (client-signed, provider can't add) vs after the signature (provider can add, unsigned).
